The recipes include Mini Pumpkin Cheesecake Cups topped with whipped cream and cinnamon; Caramel Apple Nachos drizzled with caramel and melted chocolate plus crushed nuts, chocolate chips, and mini marshmallows as a no-bake treat; Pecan Pie Brownies featuring a sticky caramelized pecan topping over baked brownies; Cinnamon Sugar Apple Donuts made from an easy batter coated while warm; Pumpkin Spice Tiramisu layering coffee-soaked ladyfingers with pumpkin-spiced mascarpone cream and dusted with cocoa powder; Cranberry White Chocolate Cookies combining dried cranberries with white chocolate chips; a No-Bake Chocolate Pecan Tart with a biscuit crust, melted chocolate, and chopped pecans that requires no oven time; Sweet Potato Marshmallow Brownies mixing mashed sweet potato into the batter and topping it with toasted mini marshmallows as an inspiration from classic Thanksgiving sweet potato casserole; Apple Crumble Cheesecake Jars layered in small jars with a crunchy crumble topping for individual servings; and a Pumpkin Pie Milkshake blending vanilla ice cream, pumpkin puree, milk, cinnamon, and nutmeg topped with whipped cream and crushed graham crackers. The article frames these as easy-to-make-at-home options suitable for home preparation.
items.title: Ten Easy Thanksgiving Dessert Recipes for a Festive Table

items.summary: Actor Shah Rukh Khan has reportedly sent a legal notice dated November 23 to social media influencer Suvigya Sharma over an Instagram reel that allegedly made misleading and defamatory claims about an interaction between the actor and businessman Anant Ambani in the presence of spiritual leader Sadhguru at a recent Mumbai event. The controversy began after Sharma's viral reel featured footage of Anant interacting with Sadhguru alongside a separate clip showing a conversation between Shah Rukh and Ambani, with Sharma claiming that Shah Rukh was asked to 'remain silent' during the interaction. In the notice, which Sharma shared on his social media account as an advocate, Shah Rukh's legal team described the content as 'mischievous, misleading and defamatory,' alleging that the video's caption distorted the context of the interaction and damaged the actor's image and reputation. The notice cited Section 356 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023, which deals with defamation, asked Sharma to comply with five demands within 48 hours, and requested written confirmation of the actions taken. However, there has been no independent official confirmation that Shah Rukh Khan or his representatives sent the notice, leaving the authenticity of the reported legal action unverified.
items.title: Shah Rukh Khan Allegedly Sends Legal Notice to Influencer Over Viral Anant Ambani Video

items.summary: A newborn girl in Cooch Behar district, West Bengal has been waiting over two months for her birth certificate after her father's name was deleted from the electoral roll during the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise. The family alleges that registration stalled because officials refused to issue a residency certificate required for the daughter's birth record; Habib said this refusal cited both the ongoing SIR exercise and his exclusion from the voter list, while noting the panchayat is also without a pradhan. His wife Amina Khatun gave birth at a state-run hospital in Dinhata on September 8, but no official birth record has been obtained despite repeated visits to government offices, where officials reportedly advised him to approach local MLA Abhijit Barman. Habib questioned why his electoral status should affect the child's registration, pointing out that his wife remains a registered voter and the family holds both parents' birth certificates plus a 2002 electoral roll carrying his father's name. The incident drew reactions from BJP, Congress and Trinamool Congress leaders: ruling BJP president Abhijit Barman said Habib should approach the tribunal to challenge the deletion and that the birth certificate would be issued per rules; Congress district president Biswajit Sarkar alleged the SIR exercise wrongly deleted genuine voters—including indigenous Muslim Rajbanshi residents like Habib—and vowed continued agitation until names are restored; Trinamool MLA Kunal Ghosh said similar complaints were emerging elsewhere and urged both state and central governments to address the issue. All political statements here are attributed to their respective leaders.
items.title: Newborn Waits Months for Birth Certificate After Father Deleted from Voter List
